calls.name: NiTPointerMap_Lookup
calls.assembly: call    NiTPointerMap_Lookup; Generic 32-bit key/value lookup. HashKey(key) selects a bucket, KeysEqual compares candidate keys, linked entries are followed via next; on hit writes the raw 32-bit value and returns true, otherwise returns false without touching output. Entry and header sizes are 0x0C and 0x10. The raw value may be a TESForm* in g_formsByID.
